title: Cross-process race through real TagDuel Discord Accept and Cancel handlers
priority: P1 — the fourth-seat Accept and host Cancel components must not both commit when delivered concurrently by separate processes; the terminal state and four physical locks must agree.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite database with independent Node processes and separate better-sqlite3 connections; parent connection closed before the races.
design.concurrency: Three synchronized races through handleTagComponent: tag:accept for the fourth seat versus tag:cancel for the host, both using the same revision.
design.clock: Deterministic non-expired time; both actions begin from the same lobby snapshot and revision.

assertions: exactly one real component handler commits and the stale competitor fails closed
Accept winner yields a valid four-seat TagDuel, four accepted members and four physical tag locks
Cancel winner preserves the three earlier acceptances, produces cancelled with null state and releases all four locks
all public payloads are validated with validateDiscordPayload before handler completion
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain unchanged
physical UIDs remain unique when the duel starts
limitations: Handlers Discord.js reais executados offline com interações falsas; sem token, gateway ou guild real.
Relógio controlado e SQLite temporário; não mede latência de produção.
Nenhuma alteração de runtime, comando, catálogo ou certificação.
